items.title: 61530_Roy Eldridge oral history interview
items.q: I think Richard Fulbright was playing bass, wasn't he?

ctx.x: pretty... Except we didn't get into that standing around like we was doing, you know. You sit down and play. But we played then, you know.
I think Richard Fulbright was playing bass, wasn't he? Yeah, he used to wear them funny hats when he played. Heh-heh...
